element: Four-node flat MITC4 shell, full 2x2 membrane/bending integration, mixed interpolated transverse shear; weak drilling rotation/curl penalty 1e-4 E t. Six DOFs per node.
modeling_assumptions: All interfaces welded, shared shell nodes with all six DOFs continuous. Exact 104-region physical solid retained in part.step; mesh.msh is the midsurface reduction.
Web thickness 15; flange thickness 50; longitudinal stiffener 20; transverse stiffeners 15 except end plates 24 mm. Web and stiffeners extend to flange midplanes, neglecting joint overlap volume.
Bottom 175x175 bearing plates represented by 100-mm-thick eccentric flange patches: reference z=25, section centroid z=0.
Supports mapped from z=2100 to z=2075 with exact rigid offset (25 mm): ux+25 theta_y=0 on left; uy-25 theta_x=0 and uz=0 both ends. All other rotations free.
All prescribed tractions integrated at their original plan locations, preserving areas, sums, and load moments; duplicate lower-patch pressures add. No self weight.

Geometric matrix integrates initial in-plane stresses and bending stresses through thickness, acting on gradients of all three displacement components and two bending rotations. Initial transverse shear/normal stress neglected in the shell reduction.
quantity_extraction: Solve Ku=F, then generalized symmetric eigenproblem -KG v = mu K v, six largest algebraic mu; lambda1 = 1 / max positive mu. Entire reference load scales together.

field_schema.node_ids: One-based mesh.msh node tags; row order matches coordinates
field_schema.connectivity: One-based node IDs of each quad, matching element row order
field_schema.coordinates_mm: N x 3 global XYZ on reference shell surface
field_schema.reference_displacement_mm: N x 3 translations in global frame
field_schema.reference_rotation_rad: N x 3 rotation vectors in global frame
field_schema.reference_stress_MPa: Ne x 4 in-plane Gauss points x 2 section surfaces (bottom,top) x 3 local stresses (xx,yy,xy). Gauss loop x then y ascending.
field_schema.buckling_modes: N x 6 x 6 modes, global translations then rotations, normalized to maximum translational vector magnitude = 1 mm
field_schema.buckling_factors: Six positive elastic load factors, ascending
field_schema.reference_nodal_load_N_Nmm: N x 6 consistent forces and moments
field_schema.reference_residual_N_Nmm: Ku-F in full DOFs, including support reaction force/couple
field_schema.support_left, support_right: Node masks at support reference lines
field_schema.constrained_dof_mask: N x 6 masks of eliminated DOFs; offset constraints described above
field_schema.load_element_masks: Ne x 3: bottom strip, bearing patch, top end load masks
field_schema.physical_group: Ne group IDs matching MSH physical tags
field_schema.thickness_mm, eccentricity_mm: Ne shell thickness and centroid offset along local normal

reduction_limitations: Shell midsurfaces extend to intersecting plate midplanes. Their integrated section volume is 1.16% greater than the exact solid because joint overlaps are not subtracted. Convergence is numerical shell-mesh convergence, not an estimate of 3D-to-shell modeling error. Local through-thickness stresses at loads and constrained edges are not resolved.
load_sign_convention: Top end traction is global -z; all bottom strip and bearing tractions are global +z. End faces have total area 27600 mm2; bearings 61250 mm2; remaining bottom strip 443250 mm2. Rounded input tractions leave net -0.11 N.
